title: 第9章 水司寨第10章 姐弟
content_zh:
大赵国境共有五条大河流贯穿全境，这五条河流又被统称为五道河，境内约莫三分之一皆是水域
蜿蜒如龙的河流以及广阔的水泊不仅形成了奇特的地理地貌也催生出各种水上人文
地处西南的水司寨原本只是靠着水域讨生活的普通宗族
只是与其他宗族不同他们更加注重后代在修士方面的发展，往往愿意花费大价钱将有灵根的弟子送往各大修仙宗门培养
经过几百年数代人的努力发展这才形成如今规模，甚至得到了大赵官家的分封掌管着这片水域
杨威想要去往的藏宝地点有着一定危险，而且带着翠翠也不方便
水司寨无疑是个很好的暂时落脚点，比之鹿城安全系数要高出一大截。
“这位道友请留步”
刚踏入码头范围便有巡查修士过来询问，显然对方也是修士一眼便看出杨威身份
水司寨以水上贸易作为主要经济来源，船业比较发达码头上人来人往的忙碌着，有的搬运货物装车，有的则择就地售卖物品
为了保证经商安全对于陌生外来修士自然是要进行盘查登记
杨威很是配合的与之交换了信息，说自己是来寨子里谋生的并透露出了自己炼丹师的身份
他明白人与人之间的关系其实就是各取所需，表现出自身的一定价值才能得到尊重
“哦，小兄弟真是年轻有为，有着炼丹才能在寨子里可是很吃香的”
在得知杨威是炼丹师这巡查修士态度都变得柔和了许多
不管在什么势力里，这种专业性人才都是极为珍贵的
没有人会与炼丹师交恶，说不定对方便能炼制出自己破境所需灵丹妙药
那人不仅与杨威介绍了一番水司寨还将他们引荐给了水寨的周管事
中午时分杨威很是顺利的便踏上了水寨中最大的主船“浔阳楼”
，其上有着一栋高达二十九层的红木复古阁楼，整体气势宏伟大气

一般新来修士是没资格进入此处的，杨威因是炼丹师才特地被带来
在周管事的带领下穿过一层层走廊楼梯最后停在了九层
铺面而来的气息都是滚烫的，这一层没有房屋更像是一个平层
放眼看去其内有着各种大小的炉鼎，其中有几个前面还站着人操纵着火焰
他们很是专注，哪怕门口来了人也不为所动，依旧调和着炉中药草
此处便是公共的炼丹房了，炼丹师们可以在这里炼丹，好处便是房中有着可以方便调用的地火
如此炼丹才是正常步骤，不怎么损耗灵力也轻松不少，杨威之前也是没有条件才会无炉炼丹
毕竟不是所有炼丹师都有着火灵根可以自由控制火焰
不过在公共场合炼丹有利也有弊好处便是可以利用寨子准备好的地火炼丹还能与众多的炼丹师交流经验心得
坏处同样明显，炼制的手艺容易被别人偷窥
杨威一眼便看出了其中利弊，他也注意到了这里的炼丹师大多炼制的是些非常简单的一阶丹药，品质皆是中品或下品
content_en:
There are five large rivers running through the territory of Da Zhao. These five rivers are collectively called Wudao River. About one-third of the territory is water.
The winding rivers and vast water ponds not only form unique geographical features, but also give rise to various water-based humanities.
Shuisizhai, located in the southwest, was originally an ordinary clan that relied on the water to make a living.
It's just that unlike other clans, they pay more attention to the development of their descendants as monks, and are often willing to spend a lot of money to send disciples with spiritual roots to major immortal cultivating sects for training.
After hundreds of years and generations of hard work, it has reached its current scale, and even got the enfeoffment of the Zhao official family to take charge of this water area.
The treasure hiding place that Yang Wei wants to go to is dangerous, and it is inconvenient to take Cuicui with him.
Shuisizhai is undoubtedly a good temporary place to stay, and its safety factor is much higher than that of Lucheng.
"This fellow Taoist, please stay."
As soon as he stepped into the dock area, a patrolling monk came over to inquire. Apparently he was also a monk and he could tell who Yang Wei was at a glance.
Shuisizhai relies on water trade as its main source of income. The shipping industry is relatively developed. The docks are busy with people coming and going. Some are carrying goods and loading them, while others are selling items on the spot.
In order to ensure the safety of doing business, strangers and foreign monks must be checked and registered.
Yang Wei was very cooperative and exchanged information with him, saying that he came to the village to make a living and revealed his identity as an alchemist.
He understands that the relationship between people is actually about getting what they need, and only by showing their own value can they be respected.
"Oh, my little brother is really young and promising. He is very popular in the village because of his talent in alchemy."
After learning that Yang Wei was an alchemist, the attitude of the patrolling monks became much softer.
No matter what force you are in, this kind of professional talent is extremely precious.
No one would quarrel with an alchemist. Maybe the other person can refine the elixir he needs to break through the situation.
The man not only introduced Yang Wei to Shui Sizhai, but also introduced them to Manager Zhou of Shui Sizhai.
At noon, Yang Wei successfully set foot on the "Xunyang Tower", the largest main ship in the water village.
, there is a mahogany retro loft with a height of 29 floors, and the overall momentum is magnificent.
Generally, new monks are not qualified to enter here. Yang Wei was brought here specially because he is an alchemist.
Under the leadership of Manager Zhou, we walked through the corridors and stairs and finally stopped on the ninth floor.
The smell coming from the pavement is hot. There are no houses on this floor and it is more like a flat floor.
Looking around, there are furnaces of various sizes inside, some of which have people standing in front of them controlling the flames.
They were very attentive. Even if someone came to the door, they would not be moved. They were still blending the herbs in the furnace.
This is the public alchemy room. Alchemists can make alchemy here. The advantage is that there is an earth fire in the room that can be easily used.
Refining elixirs in this way is a normal step, and it does not consume much spiritual energy and is much easier. Yang Wei did not have the conditions to refining elixirs without a furnace before.
After all, not all alchemists have fire roots and can freely control flames.
However, there are advantages and disadvantages to making alchemy in public places. The advantage is that you can use the earth fire prepared by the village to make alchemy, and you can also exchange experiences with many alchemists.
The disadvantages are equally obvious. The refining techniques can easily be peeped by others.
Yang Wei could see the pros and cons at a glance. He also noticed that most of the alchemists here refined some very simple first-level elixirs, all of which were of medium or low quality.
